faq.title: Frequently asked questions

items.a: The design of your store website interface on one of our templates, uploading your first {{products}} products from your materials, setting up the available invoicing, shipping and payment integrations, one round of adjustments before launch and a {{minutes}}-minute training over video call. It is a one-time payment.

items.q: What materials do I need to send?
items.a: Your logo (if you have one), product photos, names, descriptions, prices and variants (such as sizes or colours), plus the style you would like. We never ask for provider credentials through the website form; we set those up together.
The SpeedVendors platform, store hosting, platform updates and technical support. It does not include day-to-day store management, custom design or unlimited change requests.
When your store launches, from {{from}}/month. You can choose START, GROWTH or SCALE, billed monthly or annually.

items.q: What will I learn on the video call?
items.a: In {{minutes}} minutes we show you how to add and edit products, update stock, customise your store and manage orders, invoices and deliveries.

items.q: Do I need accounts with providers?
items.a: Yes. For payments, invoicing and shipping you need active accounts with the providers you choose. Their fees and your domain are paid separately, where applicable.

items.q: Can I set up the store myself?
items.a: Yes. You can create an account, try the platform free for 7 days with no card, then choose a plan. Assisted setup is optional.

faq.moreBody: Write to us and we will reply personally.
